name: Multi-hit Collection via OptiX anyhit
aliases: Collecting all intersections using anyhit in OptiX
definition: A technique to process all intersections along a ray for volume rendering on a tetrahedral mesh by modifying a payload in the anyhit shader and collecting results in the raygen program, avoiding the overhead of multiple optixTrace calls.
summary: Multi-hit Collection via OptiX anyhit processes all ray intersections in a single trace, avoiding multiple cast overhead at the cost of memory bandwidth for storing and sorting hits.
